title: cli.command.laboratories.attach.Response
description:
Confirmation — attach succeeded; echoes the laboratory id that was
attached.

laboratory_id.description: The laboratory id that was attached to the target.

machine.description:
The machine id of the laboratory host the attachment row
records (the provided pair, or the auto-filled local one).

machine_state.description: The state the attachment row records, paired with `machine`.
